archetype: Private research note — warm paper, deep pine green, antique gold. Elegant, editorial, unhurried.
emotional_tone: Sophisticated, precise, calm, trustworthy. No neon, no 'crypto-bro' energy.

typography.primary_usage: Wordmark, page headlines, section numbers, verdict banner heading. Weights 400–600, italic for accent lines.
typography.secondary_usage: Body copy, table body, descriptions. Weight 400–600.
typography.mono_usage: All numerics, prices, percentages, formula blocks, uppercase micro-labels with wide tracking.

colors.rules: No gradients anywhere. Solid fills only. Hairline warm borders, soft layered shadows, generous whitespace.

layout.table: hairline rows, uppercase mono column labels, hover pine-50 row wash
